y-m-45-01.title: Singasho njalo ukuthi 'uma kuma ngqo, umkhiqizo we-slope ungu-−1'?
y-m-45-01.topic: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-slope lapho imigqa emibili ime ngqo, nemigqa engenayo i-slope
y-m-45-01.goal: Usebenzisa ithebula lamabhanqa emigqa eme ngqo njengobufakazi, nquma ukuthi isitatimende esithi 'uma kuma ngqo, umkhiqizo we-slope ungu-−1' sibamba ebangeni muni, bese wenza imigqa enelisa isimo wena.
y-m-45-01.material:
U민재 uthe, "Uma imigqa emibili ime ngqo komunye nomunye, umkhiqizo wama-slope ayo amabili uhlala ungu-−1." Ngezansi kunamabhanqa amane emigqa epulanini lezixhumanisi. (x=2 ifundwa 'x equals 2' futhi ingumugqa o-bheke phezulu ohambisana ne-y-axis, futhi y=5 ingumugqa ovundlile ohambisana ne-x-axis. y=−x/2+4 ifundwa 'y equals minus x over 2 plus 4', futhi 3x+2y=6 ifundwa '3x plus 2y equals 6'.)
(가) y=2x+1 no-y=−x/2+4
(나) y=3x no-y=−3x
(다) x=2 no-y=5
(라) 3x+2y=6 no-2x−3y=1

y-m-45-06.title: Ukuhlola ngesethi eyodwa yezinombolo kuwubufakazi?
y-m-45-06.topic: Indlela yokubeka ama-coordinate, nokwenza okujwayelekile, uma kukhonjiswa isici sesimo ngama-coordinate
y-m-45-06.goal: Uma ukhombisa isici sesimo ngama-coordinate, hlela ukuthi yiluphi uhlelo lwama-coordinate olumela wonke unxantathu, bese uchazela umngane ukuthi kungani isixazululo esisebenzisa isimo esisodwa esikhethekile singesona ubufakazi.
y-m-45-06.material: Vumela u-M no-N babe amaphoyinti aphakathi ezinhlangothi ezimbili AB no-AC zikanxantathu ABC. Ufuna ukukhombisa ngama-coordinate ukuthi ucezu MN luhambisana nohlangothi BC futhi ubude balo buyisigamu sika-BC. (√3 ifundwa 'impande 3'.) Indlela obeka ngayo ama-coordinate ibalulekile.
y-m-45-06.prereq.1: Iphoyinti eliphakathi, ukuthambeka, nebanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili
y-m-45-06.prereq.2: Isici socezu oluxhuma amaphoyinti aphakathi ezinhlangothi ezimbili zikanxantathu (umphumela owaziwayo ezingeni lesikole sesibili)
y-m-45-06.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukukhombisa leli qiniso 'kunoma yimuphi unxantathu ABC'. Khetha zonke izinhlelo zama-coordinate ezingamela wonke unxantathu (ezingalahli ukujwayelekile). (a, b, c ziyizinhlamvu ezingakhawulelisi isimo, njengokuba yizinombolo eziphozithivu.)
y-m-45-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kuhlelo ngalunye, bheka izinhlobo zonxantathu ongazenza ngokushintsha ama-coordinate amakhoneni (ushintsha izinhlamvu noma izinombolo).
y-m-45-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ngohlelo olufanayo, hlola ukuthi ungenza unxantathu oqondile, unxantathu olinganayo, nanoma yimuphi isimo.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.a: Inqunyiwe ngezinombolo, ngakho ikhombisa unxantathu oqondile oyedwa kuphela.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.b: Uma ubeka uhlangothi olulodwa ku-x-axis nekhona elilodwa esiqalweni, ikhona elisele lisha, ngakho lingakhombisa noma yimuphi unxantathu.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.c: Inqumela i-x-coordinate ka-A ku-0, ngakho ikhombisa kuphela onxantathu abanengeli eqondile ku-B.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.d: Ikhombisa unxantathu olinganayo oyedwa kuphela lapho zonke izinhlangothi ezintathu zingu-2.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.e: Le yindlela yokubeka iphoyinti eliphakathi lohlangothi BC esiqalweni. A ikhululekile, ngakho ingakhombisa noma yimuphi unxantathu.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.f: Ibeka u-A ku-perpendicular bisector yohlangothi BC, ngakho ikhombisa kuphela onxantathu abanezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.explain: Ungawuhumusha futhi uwujikise unxantathu ukuze ubeke uhlangothi olulodwa ku-x-axis (uwuphendule uma kunesidingo ukuze u-A abe ngaphezulu kwe-x-axis) futhi ubeke ikhona elilodwa esiqalweni, noma ubeke iphoyinti eliphakathi lalolo hlangothi esiqalweni. Ubude nobudlelwano obuhambisanayo abushintshi uma ushukumisa, ngakho b no-e bamela wonke unxantathu. a, c, d, f bakhombisa kuphela onxantathu abanesimo esivele sinqunyiwe, njengonxantathu oqondile, unxantathu olinganayo, noma unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi ubeke u-A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C(0, 3) wabhala njengaphansi. Khetha umugqa oyinkinga njengobufakazi. (Ungakhetha umugqa owodwa kuphela.)
y-m-45-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bala kabusha izibalo emigqeni 2 kuya ku-4 elilodwa ngelilodwa ukubona ukuthi zilungile yini kulo nxantathu.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa izinhlobo zonxantathu ezingenziwa ngama-coordinate emugqeni 1 nebanga umugqa 5 okhuluma ngalo.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.0: Beka amakhona kanxantathu ABC njengo-A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C(0, 3).
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.1: Iphoyinti eliphakathi M le-AB ngu-(2, 0), futhi iphoyinti eliphakathi N le-AC ngu-(0, 3/2).
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.2: Ukuthambeka kwe-MN ngu-(3/2−0)/(0−2)=−3/4 futhi ukuthambeka kwe-BC ngu-(3−0)/(0−4)=−3/4, ngakho MN no-BC bayahambisana.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.3: MN=√(2²+(3/2)²)=5/2 no-BC=√(4²+3²)=5, ngakho MN iyisigamu sika-BC.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.4: Ngakho, kunoma yimuphi unxantathu, ucezu oluxhuma amaphoyinti aphakathi ezinhlangothi ezimbili luhambisana nohlangothi olusele futhi ubude balo buyisigamu salo.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.explain: Imigqa 1 no-5 yinkinga. Izibalo (imigqa 2 kuya ku-4) zonke zilungile, kodwa ngoba umugqa 1 unqume ama-coordinate ngonxantathu oqondile oyedwa, awukwazi ukuqhubekela ku-'nxantathu ngamunye' emugqeni 5. Okuhloliwe kuphela lo nxantathu owodwa.

y-m-45-08.title: Uma ushintsha ukulandelana kwezinyakazo, umphumela uyafana?
y-m-45-08.goal: Thola iphutha esixazululweni mayelana nokunyakazisa umugqa, bese uthola futhi wenze jikelele umbandela lapho ukushintsha ukulandelana kwe-translation ne-reflection emugqeni y=x kunika umphumela ofanayo.
y-m-45-08.material: Ufuna ukunyakazisa umugqa m: y=2x+1 kabili. Ukunyakaza ㉠ yi-translation ngo-3 ohlangothini lwe-x (u-3 ukuya kwesokudla), futhi ukunyakaza ㉡ yi-reflection emugqeni y=x. 지후 wenze ㉠ kuqala wabe esenza ㉡.
y-m-45-08.prereq.1: Ukuhambisa umumo (ukushintsha u-x ngo-x−a no-y ngo-y−b)

y-m-45-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni sika-지후 ophosile.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.hint.0: Khetha iphoyinti elilodwa emgqeni ohanjisiwe futhi usebenze emuva ukubona ukuthi lahanjiswa lisuka kuliphi iphoyinti emgqeni wokuqala.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.hint.1: Faka iphoyinti u-(0, 1) ku-m esibalweni somugqa omusha ukuhlola ukuthi liya kuphi uma lihanjiswa u-3 lisiya kwesokudla.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.line.0: Ukuhambisa u-m ngo-3 ohlangothini luka-x, faka u-x+3 esikhundleni luka-x: y=2(x+3)+1=2x+7.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.line.1: Ukubukisa lo mugqa ngaphesheya ku-y=x, shintshanisa u-x no-y: x=2y+7.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 1 uyaphosa. Uma uhanjiswe u-3 uya kwesokudla, iphoyinti u-(x, y) kugrafu yokuqala liya ku-(x+3, y), ngakho isibalo somugqa omusha sitholakala ngokufaka u-x−3 esikhundleni luka-x: y=2(x−3)+1=2x−5. Imigqa elandelayo isebenzisa inani lomugqa 1 njengoba linjalo. Umphumela olungile ngu-y=(x+5)/2 kusuka ku-x=2y−5.
y-m-45-08.s.s2.prompt: Kulokhu, cabanga ngephoyinti u-(1, 3). Thola amapheya angu-3 ahlukile u-(p, q) lapho iphoyinti olithola ngokuhambisa iphoyinti u-(1, 3) ngo-(p, q) bese ubukisa ngaphesheya ku-y=x lifana nephoyinti olithola ngokuqala ukubukisa ngaphesheya ku-y=x bese uhambisa ngo-(p, q). Shiya u-(0, 0). Ukuxhumanisa u-(p, q) kusho ukuhamba u-p ohlangothini luka-x no-q ohlangothini luka-y.
y-m-45-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bala indlela yephoyinti u-(1, 3) ngokuhlukile kokulandelana ngakunye, futhi ubhale ukuxhumanisa kwephoyinti lokugcina usebenzisa u-p no-q.
y-m-45-08.s.s2.hint.1: Beka ama-x-coordinate amaphoyinti amabili okugcina alingane nama-y-coordinate alingane, futhi ubone ukuthi yiluphi ubudlelwano obuvela phakathi kuka-p no-q.

y-m-45-08.s.s2.explain: Ekuhanjisweni okulandelwa ukubukisa, u-(1+p, 3+q) uya ku-(3+q, 1+p), futhi ekubukiseni okulandelwa ukuhambisa, u-(3, 1) uya ku-(3+p, 1+q). Ukuze amaphoyinti amabili afane, 3+q=3+p no-1+p=1+q, ngakho u-p=q. Izibonelo: (1, 1), (2, 2), (−3, −3).
y-m-45-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala ukuthi u-(p, q) owamthola bafana ngani, futhi uchaze emshweni owodwa noma emibili ukuthi kungani umphumela ufana noma ushintshanisa ukulandelana kuleso budlelwano.

y-m-45-08.s.s3.explain: Uma u-p=q, umphumela wokulandelana okubili uyafana kuwo wonke amaphoyinti, ngakho amagrafu nawo ayafana. Uma u-p≠q, ngokuvamile ayahluka, kodwa kunokuhlukile: umugqa u-y=−x+c uba ngumugqa ofanayo u-y=−x+c+p+q noma uwuhambisa kunoma yikuphi ukulandelana.
